Every judged row (table, id, registered test, findings as read by the census at this cut, sha256 input digest), the three claims with their propositions as audited and their shapes, and the residual families. rfCommit and citationBlobs are read-only facts of the ReactiveFiberCLI checkout at cut time (git rev-parse of the commit and of docs/programs/compositional-assembly-2026-10-18/BEADS-2026-10-21.md and README.md at it). The census judges its in-file rows against this file in order and both ways. wb-1y1p (the R694 follow-up of landing 310) adds tests: every registered test of the census, in registration order (the harness cases too), which the registration case and the roster case both hold the vitest task tree to. wb-3ohq (the R694 follow-up of landing 420) adds the rows F105-F110, N28-N31 and R30-R33, the residual families R30-R33 and the follow-up anchors case. wb-pi42 (the R694 follow-up of landing 513) adds the rows F111-F117, N32-N35 and R34-R36, the residual families R34-R36 and its follow-up anchors case.
